cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead the rota presentation. Back my decision into this microphone so the staff can hear we're together on it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already told you it's fine. I don't want to make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A sentence in your own words will do. I just need support that reaches the people who'll challenge it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Email is ideal. You choose the wording; copy the whole team and I'll present it alongside the rota. Then it's our supported decision, not just my bright idea.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently leads the rota; A3 reduces speech demands and A5 accepts email and wording control while requiring public team visibility to protect the decision.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no speech causes A3 one sentence; B4 email causes A5 copied endorsement displayed with the rota.

relationship.evidence: B2 gives private support while setting a performance boundary; B4 offers a usable alternative.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B private-message preference into distributed visible support and shared ownership.

specificity.evidence: A1 rota/staff/microphone and B4 email establish the endorsement media.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 bright-idea contrast is character vulnerability, with actual copied visibility doing the work.
